super-destroyer.title: Super Destroyer
super-destroyer.description: The Super Destroyer is a class of Super Earth military spacecraft that serves as the forward operating base for Helldivers. Each vessel carries a large number of Helldivers in cryogenic storage and provides orbital fire support, equipment deployment, reinforcements, and Eagle close air support during missions. Powered by an Element-710-fueled Alcubierre Drive, a Super Destroyer can travel between star systems in seconds.
aliases: class 6 series crewed interplanetary combat vessel

eagle.title: Eagle Aerospace Assault Craft
eagle.description: The Eagle is a Super Earth aerospace assault craft carried aboard Helldiver Super Destroyers. It provides rapid close air support during planetary operations and can carry multiple weapon configurations for bombing, strafing, rocket, and other attack missions. After expending its available ordnance, the Eagle can return to the Super Destroyer to rearm before resuming support operations.

pelican-shuttle.title: Pelican Shuttle
pelican-shuttle.description: Pelican Shuttles are Super Earth transport craft used to move personnel, vehicles, cargo, and fluids between spacecraft and planetary surfaces. They are single-stage-to-orbit tiltwing aircraft capable of vertical takeoff and landing. Known variants include Tanker, Cargo, and Troop Transport models, with specialized Pelicans supporting numerous Helldiver operations.

extraction-shuttle.title: Extraction Shuttle
extraction-shuttle.description: The Extraction Shuttle is a Pelican transport assigned to recover Helldivers from planetary operations and return them to their Super Destroyer. After being called to an extraction zone, the shuttle descends to collect surviving Helldivers. If it must remain airborne while awaiting the squad, its nose-mounted autocannon can engage nearby enemies and provide fire support around the landing zone.

m-103-supply-frv.title: M-103 Supply FRV
m-103-supply-frv.description: The M-103 Supply FRV is a high-speed Fast Recon Vehicle configured for frontline logistics. It carries a rear supply rack with eight charges that replenish ammunition, grenades, and stims, plus an automated AR-23P Liberator Penetrator turret. It shares the same basic vehicle platform as the M-102 Gunner FRV.

m-104-incinerator-frv.title: M-104 Incinerator FRV
m-104-incinerator-frv.description: The M-104 Incinerator FRV is a specialized Fast Recon Vehicle with heavier armor, a spiked ramming grille, and a roof-mounted heavy flamethrower. Its large fuel tank replaces the rear seating row, limiting the vehicle to three Helldivers. It was offered during Census Thunder as the alternative vehicle reward tied to liberating Sangis before Basquine VIII; because Basquine VIII was liberated first, the M-103 Supply FRV became the permanent reward instead.

exo-51-lumberer.title: EXO-51 Lumberer Exosuit
exo-51-lumberer.description: The EXO-51 Lumberer Exosuit is a modern Super Earth reinvention of the Lumberer used during the First Galactic War. It mounts a 75mm anti-tank cannon on the right arm and a flamethrower on the left, combining anti-armor firepower with close-range incendiary crowd control.

exo-55-breakthrough.title: EXO-55 Breakthrough Exosuit
exo-55-breakthrough.description: The EXO-55 Breakthrough Exosuit is a heavy Super Earth combat Exosuit optimized for mid-to-close-range fighting. Its right arm mounts a heavy flak cannon while its left carries a massive ballistic shield that protects the pilot while closing distance and can also be used offensively to strike and stagger enemies.

m-102-gunner-frv.title: M-102 Gunner FRV
m-102-gunner-frv.description: The M-102 Gunner FRV is a lightly armored four-wheeled Fast Recon Vehicle used by Helldivers for rapid transport and mobile fire support. It mounts an MG-206 Heavy Machine Gun. Originally named the M-102 Fast Recon Vehicle, it was renamed the M-102 Gunner FRV in patch 1.006.300 as additional specialized FRV variants entered service.

exo-45-patriot.title: EXO-45 Patriot Exosuit
exo-45-patriot.description: The EXO-45 Patriot is a heavily armored Super Earth combat Exosuit equipped with a rapid-firing gatling gun and a rocket launcher. Its mixed armament allows it to engage both large groups of lighter enemies and heavily armored targets. Production of the Patriot is associated with the Morgunson Arsenal on Tien Kwan, which Helldivers liberated in March 2184 before the Exosuit became available for fleet-wide requisition.

exo-49-emancipator.title: EXO-49 Emancipator Exosuit
exo-49-emancipator.description: The EXO-49 Emancipator is a heavily armored Super Earth combat Exosuit equipped with dual autocannons for sustained explosive firepower. The design entered service after Helldivers liberated an Automaton Petafactory on Varylia 5 in May 2184. Super Earth engineers subsequently converted the captured facility to manufacture Emancipator Exosuits, which were distributed for Helldiver use.

bt-1317.title: BT-1317
bt-1317.description: The BT-1317 is a large Super Earth aircraft whose base configuration appears to serve as a bomber. The four-engine craft carries two quad-barreled autocannons, with one mounted above the aircraft and another positioned toward the rear. Several specialized variants are known from wreckage encountered by Helldivers, including Weather Reconnaissance and Strategic Reconnaissance versions.

super-earth-fighter-craft.title: Unnamed Super Earth Fighter Craft
super-earth-fighter-craft.description: An unnamed Super Earth aerospace fighter craft has been observed operating alongside Federation forces during the Second Galactic War. Formations of four aircraft conducted active sorties over Cyberstan during Operation Valid Pretext, and the craft can also appear on planets receiving Eagle Storm support from the Democracy Space Station. Its design appears more specialized toward air-to-air combat than the Eagle aerospace assault craft.

td-220-bastion.title: TD-220 Bastion MK XVI
td-220-bastion.description: The TD-220 Bastion MK XVI is a heavily armored Super Earth tank destroyer deployed as a Helldiver Stratagem. The tracked vehicle is armed with a 120mm high-velocity cannon and a heavy coaxial machine gun. It is operated by a driver and gunner while also providing positions for two additional Helldiver passengers, allowing an entire squad to travel aboard the vehicle.
